title: 第1863章 太乙洞天第1862章 签订契约
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
正殿中陷入了短暂的沉默。太虚剑宗最高剑誓是以剑心为引刻入神魂的约束，一旦违背，剑心破碎，修为尽废。这是太虚剑宗最重的誓言，历代首席弟子中从未有人主动提出过。一直没有表态的太虚剑宗宗主忽然开口，问不灭之魂可敢自己进来，当着各峰峰主的面说清楚。
殿门缓缓打开，不灭之魂从殿外走了进来。它那暗银色的虚空本源躯体在正殿的剑意威压下微微颤动，但步伐没有丝毫迟疑。它在众目睽睽之下走到正殿中央，单膝跪地，右手按在胸口，行了一个虚冥族最古老的礼节。然后它抬起头，用低沉而平静的虚空共鸣向在座的每一位峰主一板一眼地认真说道：“我，不灭之魂，虚冥族最后的遗孤。自我被创造以来，已在封印中沉睡。我从未吞噬过任何生灵，今后也不会。我愿接受任何形式的约束，只求诸位前辈允许我以盟友身份留在江辰身边。他不是我的主人，我也不是他的宠物。我们是平等的盟友。”
地剑峰峰主眯起眼睛盯着它看了很久，忽然问道：“你是虚空巨兽，以吞噬虚空本源为生。若不吞噬生灵，你如何维持自身存在？”不灭之魂抬起右手指向殿外那片淡金色的星空，认真地回答：“虚空中游离的虚空能量足够我维持生命。若不够，江辰身边有一对噬天虫，它们可以吞噬废料产出虚空仙金，我以虚空仙金为食，绝不碰任何生灵。”
几位峰主面面相觑。让一只星空巨兽吃仙金过活，这种事他们活了数十万年还是头一次听说。玄剑峰峰主饶有兴趣地问它，它真的愿意一辈子不吃活物？不灭之魂放下手臂，看着那位峰主的眼睛认真地说了两个字：“愿意。”
剑玄真人终于拍了板。这位金仙境初期的老峰主站起身来走到不灭之魂面前，低头看着这只跪在地上的巨兽，问它可愿接受太虚剑宗的剑誓约束。不灭之魂抬起头，坚定地说了三个字：“我愿意。”剑玄真人让江辰以太虚剑宗最高剑誓立下保证，然后将此决议上报宗主及太上长老会备案。他环顾各峰峰主，沉声说道，这只巨兽的生死去留以后由太虚剑宗共同监督，若有不妥，随时可重新议处。
走出太虚峰正殿时，不灭之魂跟在江辰身后沉默了很久。它抬头看着剑渊星上那片被剑意云雾笼罩的淡金色星空，忽然用极低的声音说道：“归墟说得对。你和他不一样。”江辰没有回头，只是将噬渊剑系回腰间。肩头那两只噬天虫从不灭之魂出现后就一直处于好奇的亢奋状态，此刻终于忍不住从他衣领里探出脑袋，用触角小心翼翼地碰了碰不灭之魂的肩膀。不灭之魂低头看着这两只只有手掌大小的虫子，那双淡银眼眸中闪过一丝极淡的笑意，那是它自被创造以来，第一次笑。
太乙洞天的使团来得比江辰预想的更快。不灭之魂在太虚剑宗住下后不到数日，太虚峰山门外的星港便传来消息：太乙洞天副洞主玄炉真人，之前在炼器大会上代表太乙洞天接待江辰的那位天仙巅峰炼器宗师，亲率使团抵达剑渊星，求见太虚剑宗宗主及天剑峰首席弟子江辰。使团阵仗极大，光是随行的核心长老便有十余人之多，更带着数艘满载礼物的运输舰。那些礼物被逐一抬进太虚峰正殿时，连见多识广的太虚峰执事都忍不住多看了几眼：数件上古金仙遗留下来的完整法器，每一件都散发着令人心悸的仙元波动；一批极其稀有、连太虚仙域六大势力中都早已绝迹多年的圣器材料，其中包括拳头大小的星辰母金和数块万年玄冰髓；还有一批专供不灭之魂稳定虚空本源的虚空晶石。
玄炉真人站在正殿中央，依旧是那副直爽热情的模样，一双满是老茧的大手捧着礼单，言辞恳切：“江首席，门主对不灭之魂这种拥有自我意识的星空巨兽非常感兴趣，纯粹是出于学术研究的目的，绝无他意。太乙洞天愿以数件上古金仙法器和这批圣器材料作为交换，只求获得对不灭之魂的‘研究权’，仅限于每年前往太虚剑宗进行一次常规观测，所有观测数据与剑宗共享。这是礼单，还请首席过目。”
江辰没有去接那份礼单，只是平静地看了玄炉真人一眼，语气平淡却不容置疑：“玄炉前辈，不灭之魂不是物品。它是我的盟友，不是用来交易的商品。研究权也好，观测权也罢，在未经它本人同意之前，我不会替它做任何决定。如果太乙洞天真有学术上的兴趣，可以派学者来剑宗交流，前提是必须得到它的允许。”
玄炉真人脸上的笑容渐渐凝固。他沉默了数息，将礼单缓缓收回袖中，语气也从热情转为冷淡：“江首席，老夫以诚相待，你却连谈都不愿谈。不灭之魂是虚冥族创造的巨兽，太虚仙域六大势力都有权了解它的秘密。你将它独占在太虚剑宗，就不怕引来众怒？”
“众怒？”江辰微微挑眉，“虚空之胃在太虚仙域边缘吞噬修真星时，太乙洞天可曾派人出过一兵一卒？吞噬之喉在第七星域肆虐时，太乙洞天可曾派过一支援军？现在不灭之魂被我带回来了，你们倒是想起来了。玄炉前辈，研究权不是这样要的。”
玄炉真人的脸色彻底沉了下来。他拂袖转身，带着使团头也不回地朝殿外走去，临出门前冷冷地丢下一句话：“江首席，今日之拒，老夫记下了。太乙洞天虽不是六大势力中最强的，但也不是任人欺辱的软柿子。此事不会就此罢休，告辞。”
消息很快传遍了太虚剑宗。陆川在剑庐里拍桌子骂太乙洞天不要脸，剑玄真人听完汇报后沉默了片刻，只说了四个字：“做得对。不必管他们说什么，太虚剑宗还没沦落到要靠出卖弟子来换资源的地步。”
content_en:
There was a brief silence in the main hall. The highest sword oath of the Taixu Sword Sect is a restraint engraved into the soul with the heart of the sword as the guide. Once violated, the heart of the sword will be broken and the cultivation will be ruined. This is the most important oath of the Taixu Sword Sect, and no one among the chief disciples in the past has ever taken the initiative to make it. The leader of the Taixu Sword Sect, who had been silent all this time, suddenly spoke up and asked the Immortal Soul if he dared to come in on his own and make it clear in front of the peak leaders.
The palace door slowly opened, and the immortal soul walked in from outside the palace. Its dark silver void origin body trembled slightly under the pressure of the sword in the main hall, but its steps did not hesitate at all. It walked to the center of the main hall in full view of everyone, knelt down on one knee, put its right hand on its chest, and performed the oldest etiquette of the Xuming Clan. Then it raised its head and said seriously to every peak master present with a low and calm void resonance: "I, the immortal soul, the last orphan of the Void Clan. I have been sleeping in the seal since I was created. I have never swallowed any living beings, and I will not in the future. I am willing to accept any form of restraint, and I only ask that the seniors allow me to stay with Jiang Chen as an ally. He is not my master, and I am not his pet. We are equal allies."
The master of Earth Sword Peak narrowed his eyes and stared at it for a long time, and suddenly asked: "You are a giant beast of the void, and you make a living by devouring the source of the void. If you don't devoure living things, how can you maintain your own existence?" The Immortal Soul raised his right hand and pointed at the light golden field outside the temple. Xingkong answered seriously: "The free void energy in the void is enough to sustain my life. If it's not enough, Jiang Chen has a pair of sky-devouring insects beside him. They can devour waste and produce void fairy gold. I feed on the void fairy gold and will never touch any living thing."
Several peak masters looked at each other. It was the first time they had heard of such a thing in their hundreds of thousands of years of living by letting a giant beast in the starry sky eat immortal gold. The master of Xuanjian Peak asked it with great interest, is it really willing not to eat living animals for the rest of its life? The Immortal Soul put down his arm, looked into the peak master's eyes and said two words seriously: "Yes."
Master Jianxuan finally made the decision. The old peak master in the early stage of the Golden Fairy Realm stood up and walked to the Immortal Soul. He looked down at the giant beast kneeling on the ground and asked it if it was willing to accept the sword oath of the Taixu Sword Sect. The Immortal Soul raised his head and said three words firmly: "I am willing." Master Jianxuan asked Jiang Chen to swear the Supreme Sword Oath of the Taixu Sword Sect, and then reported this resolution to the sect leader and the Taishang Elder Council for record. He looked around at the peak masters and said in a deep voice that the life and death of this giant beast would be jointly supervised by the Taixu Sword Sect. If anything goes wrong, the matter can be renegotiated at any time.
When walking out of the main hall of Taixu Peak, the immortal soul followed Jiang Chen in silence for a long time. It looked up at the pale golden starry sky on Jian Yuan Star that was shrouded in sword intent clouds, and suddenly said in a very low voice: "Guixu is right. You are different from him." Jiang Chen did not look back, but tied the Abyss Devouring Sword back to his waist. The two sky-devouring insects on the shoulders had been in a state of curiosity and excitement since the Eternal Soul appeared. At this moment, they finally couldn't help but poke their heads out of his collar and carefully touched the Immortal Soul's shoulders with their tentacles. The Immortal Soul looked down at the two palm-sized bugs, and a faint smile flashed in its pale silver eyes. It was the first time it had smiled since its creation.
The delegation from Taiyi Dongtian arrived faster than Jiang Chen expected. Less than a few days after the Immortal Soul settled in Taixu Sword Sect, news came from the star port outside the gate of Taixu Peak: Taiyi Cave Master Xuanlu Zhenren, the peak immortal weapon refining master who had previously received Jiang Chen on behalf of Taiyi Cave Heaven at the weapon refining conference, personally led a delegation to Jianyuan Star to ask for an audience with Jiang Chen, the master of Taixu Sword Sect and the chief disciple of Tianjian Peak. The mission was huge, with more than ten core elders accompanying them, and several transport ships loaded with gifts. When the gifts were carried into the main hall of Taixu Peak one by one, even the well-informed Taixu Peak deacon couldn't help but look at them a few more times.Eyes: Several complete magical artifacts left behind by ancient golden immortals, each exuding heart-stopping immortal energy fluctuations; a batch of extremely rare sacred artifact materials that have been extinct for many years even among the six major forces in the Taixu Immortal Realm, including fist-sized mother gold of stars and tens of thousands of years of black ice marrow; and a batch of void crystals specially designed for the immortal soul to stabilize the origin of the void.
Master Xuanlu stood in the center of the main hall, still looking straightforward and enthusiastic, holding a gift list in his big calloused hands, and said sincerely: "Chief Jiang, the sect master is very interested in the self-aware starry sky beast like the Immortal Soul. It is purely for academic research purposes, and absolutely nothing." He wishes. In exchange for several ancient Golden Immortal artifacts and these sacred artifact materials, Taiyi Dongtian only wants to obtain the "right to research" the Immortal Soul, which is limited to one regular observation by the Taixu Sword Sect. This is a gift list, please take a look at it."
Jiang Chen did not accept the gift list, but just looked at Master Xuanlu calmly, and said in a calm but unquestionable tone: "Senior Xuanlu, the immortal soul is not an object. It is my ally, not a commodity for trading. Whether it is research rights or observation rights, I will not make any decisions for it without its own consent. If Taiyi Dongzhen has academic interests, he can send scholars to Sword Sect for exchanges, provided that he gets his permission."
The smile on Master Xuanlu's face gradually solidified. He was silent for a few breaths, then slowly put the gift sheet back into his sleeve, and his tone also changed from enthusiasm to coldness: "Chief Jiang, I treat you with sincerity, but you don't even want to talk about it. The Immortal Soul is a giant beast created by the Void Clan, and the six major forces in the Taixu Immortal Domain have the right to know its secrets. Are you not afraid of attracting public anger by monopolizing it in the Taixu Sword Sect?"
"Public outrage?" Jiang Chen raised his eyebrows slightly, "When the Maw of the Void devoured the Cultivation Star at the edge of the Taixu Immortal Realm, did Taiyi Dongtian send out a single soldier? When the Devouring Throat was raging in the Seventh Star Realm, did Taiyi Dongtian send a support force? Now that I have brought the Immortal Soul back, you have remembered it. Senior Xuanlu, this is not what you want for research rights."
Master Xuanlu's face completely darkened. He turned around with a flick of his sleeves and walked out of the palace with the envoy without looking back. Before leaving the door, he coldly dropped a sentence: "Chief Jiang, I have made a note of today's rejection. Although Taiyi Dongtian is not the strongest among the six major forces, he is not a soft persimmon who allows others to bully him. I will not let this matter go. I'll say goodbye."
The news quickly spread throughout the Taixu Sword Sect. Lu Chuan banged the table in the sword hut and scolded Taiyi Dongtian for being shameless. Master Jianxuan was silent for a moment after listening to the report, and only said four words: "It's right. Don't worry about what they say, Taixu Sword Sect has not fallen to the point of selling out its disciples in exchange for resources."
